question: What divine capacity is attained by becoming equal in strength to the speaker?
premises: One becomes equal in strength to the speaker.
This state is described as having been attained.
The result is the power to effect dissolution and creation.
inference: Attaining equality with the speaker grants power over dissolution and creation.
uncertainties: The identity of the speaker is implied but not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Having become equal in strength to me, one becomes capable of dissolution and creation.
